# Kivilo

> Kivilo is a property handover and tenancy record app for property agents, landlords and tenants, built for Singapore.

## What Kivilo does

- At check-in, inspectors capture room photos and narrated video, write the inventory themselves, review each room, and send the condition report for landlord and tenant signatures.
- Inspectors can mark photos immediately with circles, freehand drawings and arrows, then save them with the room or inventory item. Marks stay separate from the original photo and remain editable until the report is sent for signature.
- Landlords and tenants can sign on the agent's device or through their own authenticated account. Completed reports can be shared through a private, revocable link and downloaded as a PDF.
- During the tenancy, Kivilo keeps repair records, supporting documents and acknowledged updates to the signed check-in.
- At check-out, inspectors compare the property against the agreed check-in, record changes and their assessment of damage or fair wear, and publish a dated assessment.
- Kivilo records a deposit statement and the parties' responses. It does not hold or move deposits.
- Inspectors write the condition reports. Kivilo does not use AI to write inventories or decide damage liability.

Kivilo is operated by NotTooSweetLabs Pte. Ltd. in Singapore. Support: hello@nottoosweetlabs.com.

## Public pages

- [Kivilo](https://kivilo.app/): Product overview and how it works.
- [Support](https://my.kivilo.app/support): Help with the app and account requests.
- [Check a report](https://my.kivilo.app/verify): Check a report PDF's fingerprint without uploading the file.
- [Privacy policy](https://my.kivilo.app/privacy): Data handling, sharing and retention.
- [Account deletion](https://my.kivilo.app/delete-account): Deletion requests and retention information.

Property records, signing pages, report links and supporting documents are private working content, not public product documentation.
